recent_posts.title: NEXT.JS 16 VS TANSTACK START (2026): PERFORMANCE, MEMORY LEAKS & MIGRATION GUIDE
recent_posts.summary: A team migrated their SaaS from Next.js to TanStack Start, cutting local dev startup time from 12 seconds to 2 seconds. Key pain points with Next.js included App Router complexity, opaque cache directives, production memory leaks causing OOMKilled Kubernetes pods at 9GB, the React2Shell CVSS 10.0 security vulnerability in RSCs, and Vercel vendor lock-in. TanStack Start's Vite-based runner, explicit Node architecture, and standard container builds resolved these issues. The migration used a phased strangler-fig approach with Nginx proxying, moving high-friction dashboards first rather than a full rewrite.

recent_posts.title: Your organic traffic isn't dying. It's being hijacked.
recent_posts.summary: Organic search traffic is declining not due to technical errors but because AI assistants like ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Claude are intercepting users before they reach traditional search results. The post argues that websites must shift from human-readable content to machine-parseable formats, covering tactics like proper robots.txt configuration, deploying an llms.txt file, semantic HTML structuring, and JSON-LD schema injection to ensure AI agents can cite and surface your content.

recent_posts.title: Fixing the "Unknown Utility Class" error in Tailwind v4
recent_posts.summary: Tailwind CSS v4's new Rust-powered Oxide engine changes how CSS scoping works, causing `Cannot apply unknown utility class` errors and broken `@apply` directives. A remediation guide covers fixes including the new `@reference` directive for restoring theme context, framework-specific solutions for Next.js 15, Blazor, and Vue/Svelte OOM crashes, a `.gitignore` gotcha that causes Tailwind to silently ignore node_modules and UI libraries, and how to suppress `css(unknownAtRules)` warnings in VS Code.

recent_posts.title: NEXT.JS 16.1 MIGRATION: REFACTORING MIDDLEWARE.TS TO PROXY.TS (WITHOUT BREAKING AUTH
recent_posts.summary: Next.js 16.1 introduces a breaking change by renaming middleware.ts to proxy.ts and shifting from Edge Runtime to Node.js runtime. The migration requires updating file exports, converting synchronous cookie/header access to async (due to React 19 alignment), and refactoring authentication logic to avoid common pitfalls like logout loops. Vercel provides a codemod for basic migration, but authentication implementations with Supabase, Auth.js, or Clerk need careful restructuring to separate optimistic checks in proxy.ts from actual validation in server components.

recent_posts.title: Mermaidcn - Mermaid diagrams for React
recent_posts.summary: Mermaidcn is a React component library that renders Mermaid.js diagrams with built-in zoom and pan functionality. It's designed to be compatible with shadcn UI components and offers a simple copy-paste-render workflow for integrating diagram visualization into React applications.

recent_posts.title: Web Developer Roadmap 2026: A Complete MERN Stack Guide with Real Projects
recent_posts.summary: A structured learning path for aspiring web developers covers the MERN stack (MongoDB, Express, React, Node.js) from fundamentals to deployment. The roadmap emphasizes building real projects early, understanding core concepts before frameworks, and creating a portfolio with live deployments. Key topics include HTML/CSS basics, JavaScript fundamentals, React with state management (Redux Toolkit, TanStack Query), backend development with Express, database design, authentication, and deployment strategies using Vercel and Render.

recent_posts.title: Pharmacy Inventory & Stock Management website made with AI
recent_posts.summary: A developer built a comprehensive inventory and POS system for small retail shops, featuring product management, billing, transaction history, financial dashboards, and analytics. The system includes region-specific features like credit ledger management (Khata) for South Asian markets and AI-powered business insights based on actual sales data. Built with Supabase for authentication, the project handles real-world retail scenarios including box vs loose item sales, expiry tracking, and low-stock alerts. The creator is seeking community feedback on missing features, potential improvements, and scaling considerations.

recent_posts.title: PgPlayground – Batteries included browser only playground for Postgres
recent_posts.summary: A browser-based PostgreSQL playground that runs entirely in the browser without requiring server setup. Built with PGLite (WebAssembly-compiled Postgres), Svelte 5, and Monaco editor, it provides an interactive environment for experimenting with SQL queries and database operations directly from your browser.

recent_posts.title: I made a tool to understand why stocks move the way they do
recent_posts.summary: Stock Pulse is an AI-powered stock analysis platform that analyzes 10-Q filings, earnings reports, and financial data to surface insights and trends. The application is built with Next.js App Router, Firebase for authentication and database, React Query for data fetching, Zustand for state management, Recharts for visualization, and OpenAI API for AI-driven analysis. The platform is hosted on Vercel and available for free use.
